# tg_node_tag (Resource)

Manages one node tag without replacing other tags. Import with `node_id/name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tg_node_tag" "purpose" {
  node_id = "35ee5516-c6d5-409b-b1ba-6aa2d0dd92fc"
  name    = "purpose"
  value   = "agent-first-demo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag key.
- `node_id` (String) Node UID.
- `value` (String) Tag value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
